subject.title: Rincon del Diablo Municipal Water District Board, Division 3

text: My family’s roots in Escondido date back to 1969, and I am proud to have served our community as your appointed Director for Division 3 of the Rincon del Diablo Municipal Water District. Having lived in Division 3 for the past 10 years, I consider it a privilege to represent my neighbors and respectfully ask for your support to continue serving our community.
My commitment is straightforward: to ensure a dependable, safe, and reliable water supply at a fair and affordable cost for the residents and businesses of our district.

I was raised in Escondido and graduated from Escondido High School and San Diego State University. My father, a retired Escondido Fire Captain, still lives in the family home purchased in 1971. As a child, I rode on the old fire truck in the annual Christmas Parade and delivered newspapers for the Times-Advocate beginning at age 10. Those experiences, along with my family’s example of public service, instilled in me the values of hard work, accountability, and giving back to the community.

My 45-year business career began in entry-level positions and ultimately led to executive leadership of several publicly traded companies. Along the way, I learned the importance of fiscal responsibility, strategic planning, employee safety, and building organizations that operate efficiently and sustainably. These experiences provide valuable perspective as I fulfill my fiduciary responsibility to oversee the district’s finances, infrastructure, and long-term planning on behalf of our ratepayers.
My wife, Cathy, and I raised our two children and we are now blessed with grandchildren. Protecting the quality, reliability, and affordability of our water supply matters to me.

Like all water agencies, Rincon faces important challenges and opportunities, including maintaining infrastructure, planning for future water reliability, and managing costs responsibly. Thanks to a dedicated board and an exceptional staff, our district is well-positioned to meet those challenges while continuing to provide outstanding service.

It has been an honor to serve the residents of Division 3. I would be grateful for the opportunity to continue working on your behalf, bringing experienced leadership, sound financial judgment, and a steadfast commitment to preserving the district’s legacy of responsible stewardship for future generations.

text: Water is critical infrastructure, and for over 30 years, I have made it my life’s work to protect the systems our community depends on. I served 22 years in the military and have spent more than 12 years since as a Cybersecurity Engineer defending critical infrastructure. I know what it takes to keep essential systems reliable, resilient, and accountable, because in my career, failure was never an option. I’ve been a Rincon del Diablo Division 3 customer for 25 years. Over the past year, I’ve worked to earn this seat, not just seek it: attending Board meetings, completing Water Distribution Operator coursework, and finishing the Water Citizens Academy. I continue to lead veteran organizations across Escondido, building coalitions and delivering real results for our community. I hold a bachelor’s degree and a master’s degree, and I bring the same discipline to public service that I brought to protecting national infrastructure. As a husband and father, I understand what’s at stake when families depend on safe, reliable, and affordable water. If elected, my priorities will be responsible fiscal management, reliable infrastructure, and long-term water security. I will show up prepared, ask the hard questions, and keep residents informed. While also maintaining and improving the systems our community relies on every day, such as planning for drought, growth, and future challenges with sound science and practical solutions. I believe good governance means listening first. I will work collaboratively with fellow Board members, staff, and residents to make decisions grounded in facts and in the best interests of Division 3. I’ve spent my career protecting what matters to our nation. Now I’m ready to bring that same commitment to what matters most to our Escondido community: your water. I would be honored to earn your trust and your vote. Please check out my website to learn more about me and how I am ready to serve the voters of Rincon del Diablo Division 3. http://www.abel4waterboard.com
